descriptor: A cancer science lab for students. Guess what will happen, then watch the real science. Ano helps you find out why.

belief.title: Chemo acts on busy cells
belief.detail: Hair follicle cells divide fast, so they're affected too

run.guess: It grows by the same amount every month

belief.title: Doubling hides, then surprises
belief.detail: That's why finding it early matters

run.guess: They keep dividing and pile up

belief.title: Normal cells know when to stop
belief.detail: Cancer cells ignore the stop signal and keep going

lowerBand.heading: Learn why your intuition tripped.
lowerBand.body: Some popular ideas about cancer are wrong, even when they seem to make sense. Guess first, then watch the real science.

chip.title: How it works
chip.subtitle: Guess, run it, see what really happens

meta: A science lab where you guess first

how.title: How it works

steps.title: Guess
steps.body: Every experiment starts with your guess. Here's one: when chemo starts, what happens to the hair follicle cells?

steps.title: Run
steps.body: Press Run and watch the real simulation. Chemo works on cells while they divide, so watch the busy dishes.

steps.title: Reveal
steps.body: Your guess was "nothing happens". Ano shows your idea beside what really happened, and the moment they split.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Hair follicle cells divide fast, so chemo affects them too. Most hair loss from chemo is reversible once treatment is over.

how.revealRight: You guessed right! Ano shows what really happened, then asks you why.
how.revealWrong: Your guess was "{guess}". Ano shows your idea beside what really happened, and the moment they split.

labs.title: Four labs, one story
labs.body: What cancer is, preventing it, finding it early and treating it. You always guess first.

meetAno.title: Meet Ano
meetAno.body: Your lab partner. When an experiment surprises you, Ano helps you find out why, one small step at a time.

lines.happy: Hey, I'm Ano. Want to see what's really going on inside a cell?
lines.curious: Ooh. So, what do you think will happen?
lines.thinking: Hmm. Which cells are the busiest here?
lines.surprised: Whoa, did you see that? Lots of people expect that. Let's look closer.
lines.celebrating: You got it. That's how a scientist thinks.

beliefs.title: Ideas to test
beliefs.body: Lots of people believe these. Each one has an experiment that puts it to the test.

levels.title: Pick your level
levels.body: Turn the knob to your grade. The big tile shows your level. Its experiments sit on the shelf below.

cta.line: Guess first. Then watch the real science.

footer.line: A cancer science lab for curious students. Your progress stays on this device.

learningNote: This is for learning, not medical advice. If you have questions about cancer or your health, talk to a parent, teacher or doctor.

problem.title: Myths · spread fast.

myths.myth: You can catch cancer from someone.
myths.fact: You can't. It starts from changes in a person's own cells.
It also affects other cells that divide fast, like hair cells. That's why hair can fall out.

myths.myth: A tumour grows slowly and steadily.
myths.fact: Its cells keep doubling, and each doubling adds more than the last. Found early, treatment is more likely to work.

problem.close: Guess first. Then watch the real science.
